d:
Bihar ke svasthy mantri nishant kumar ne AI se juri konphrens aur svasthy sevaon men aartiphishiyal intelijens ke upyog ko lekar bayan diya hai. unhonne kaha ki konphrens men kaee kanpniyon ne apni prastuti di aur AI ke madhyam se janta ko behtar va aadhunik svasthy suvidhaen uplabdh karaee ja sakti hain.
Behtar svasthy suvidhaen aur sabhi taknikon ko AI se jorne par nishant kumar ka bayan
